5-pin single-pole double-throw electromechanical relay. Coil drives SPDT contacts with native switch hysteresis. Optional integrated flyback diode.

![Relay (SPDT)](../../../../assets/docs/parts/relay.png)

| Pin       | Signals |
| --------- | ------- |
| **COIL+** | —       |
| **COIL-** | —       |
| **NO**    | —       |
| **COM**   | —       |
| **NC**    | —       |

Editable from the [part inspector](/docs/circuit-editor/part-inspector/):

| Attribute         | Default | Description                          |
| ----------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `coil_voltage`    | `5`     | Nominal coil voltage (V)             |
| `coil_resistance` | `70`    | Coil resistance (Ω)                  |
| `include_flyback` | `true`  | Integrated flyback diode across coil |
